summary: Read one signed integer that fits in 32 bits. Swap the decimal digits end for end, and keep a minus sign at the front when the input is negative. Values that can be stored lie on the closed span from negative two raised to the thirty-first power through two raised to the thirty-first power minus one. If the swapped result falls outside that span, write 0. If it stays inside, write the swapped integer. Drop zeros that would sit at the high end after the swap.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
